title: Timeline manifest suites compile into grouped test executables

installed_sdk.rationale: Only the test executables behind existing CTest registrations change; no SDK header, target or symbol is installed or altered.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No offline Timeline command gains, loses or changes behaviour; the change is how test suites are linked.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation is added or altered.

live_product_control.rationale: Linking test suites into shared executables creates no product capability, grant or policy projection.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: The change describes no authoring capability; every test keeps its name, labels and properties.
